chunks: Yūnus, from al-Mufaḍḍal ibn Ṣāliḥ, from Zayd al-Shaḥḥām, from Abī ʿAbdillāh; and Samāʿah ibn Mihrān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: concerning
a man and a woman who are found under one blanket, he said: He said, “They shall be flogged one hundred lashes minus one lash.”

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man mentioned in the legal case
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman mentioned in the legal case
key_terms.سَوْطٍ: a lash or stroke of flogging
key_terms.لِحَافٍ: a blanket or covering under which they are found
key_terms.مِائَةً: one hundred, referring to the number of lashes

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām on a man and a woman found under one blanket?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a man and a woman found together under a single blanket. It states a discretionary punitive measure expressed here as one hundred lashes less one, indicating the seriousness of illicitly compromising conduct in Shia fiqh.
